requirement.description: The get_domain_separator function fails with "ValueError: non-hexadecimal number found in fromhex() arg at position 1" due to improper handling of hexadecimal conversion when processing domain values, specifically with chainId and verifyingContract fields.
requirement.contract: Fix the hexadecimal conversion in get_domain_separator to properly handle integer chainId values and address strings. The function should correctly convert chainId to raw hex format and ensure verifyingContract is properly formatted as an address before concatenation.

requirement.description: The sign_transaction function fails with "Exception: cannot rlp encode items of type <class 'NoneType'>" when transaction fields contain None values that aren't properly handled before RLP encoding.
requirement.contract: Modify the standardize_transaction function to validate and handle None values in transaction fields before they are passed to signing functions. Ensure all required transaction fields are properly initialized and validated.

requirement.description: The test_max_positional_args test fails because several functions exceed the maximum of 2 positional arguments, requiring refactoring to use keyword-only arguments.
requirement.contract: Refactor functions that exceed the maximum of 2 positional arguments to use keyword-only arguments by adding '*' in function signatures. This ensures better API design and prevents breaking changes.
